raw_segments.text: Hamlet, I lady, twas my word. To Polonius. Thou wretched, rash, intruding fool, farewell.
I took thee for thy better. Take thy fortune, thou findst thee to be too busy as some danger.
Leave ringing of your hands. Peace, sit you down, and let me ring your heart, for so I
shall if it be made of penetrable stuff, if damned custom have not brazed it so, that
it is proof and bulwark against sense.
